description: Turns an older report of type GoogleSlides or MicrosoftPowerPoint, which updates a Google Slides presentation or a PowerPoint file in OneDrive or SharePoint, into a new report of type SlideDeck, as Convert to Rollstack slides in the app does. The new report gets the file's slides, and each sync that can be converted becomes a datasheet reading the same source, drawn by a tile where the sync's chart, table or picture was. The older report and its file stay as they are. The file is read with the older report's owner's account. Answers the new report and what became of each sync, with the reason for one not converted, such as a burst variant's or one of a source with no datasheets: a converted chart with needsRun stays empty until the new report's first run, so start one with startReportRun. Only the older report's editors may. It answers once the conversion ends, which can take a few minutes for a large report: send an Idempotency-Key (MCP: idempotencyKey) so a retry doesn't convert it twice. Counts against the 10 imports a minute per user.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

folderId.description: The folder to put the new report in, by its `id` from `listFolders`; it must be one you can add reports to. If omitted, it goes at the top level, as in the app.

name.description: Name for the new report, as members will see it in Rollstack. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and it can't be blank. If omitted, it takes the older report's name.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: convertReport
title: Convert report to slide deck
